crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.
The cherubim lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels…
Yahweh said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for Yahweh, the God…

translations.web: Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.
translations.bsb: and the glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east.
translations.kjv: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
translations.asv: And the glory of Jehovah came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
